senses.gloss: m. (Gordianus) Gordian, name of a gold denar coined by one of the Roman emperors of that name.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:4:11">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10:3">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite> Diocletian possessed (of that sort of gold) <he>משקל דינר ג׳</he> only the weight of a Gordian denar.

Lev. R. s. 7 כעובי דינר גרדיון היה בו (corr. acc.) the bronze plate on the altar was as thick as a G. denar; Y. Ḥag. III, end, 79ᵈ.—Cant. R. l. c. משקל גורדינון; Num. R. l. c. משקל דינר גורדייני; Men. 29ᵃ דינר זהב קורדיקיני (corr. קורדייני).—Y. Gitt. IV, 47ᵇ [read:] קרקע דינרא גרדיינא רביע מעות טרימיסא (ed. דינר אגרמא … סרימיסין) for a piece of land bought for a Gordian denar,—if he chooses to pay to the original owner the due indemnity of the fourth portion in money (instead of land), he must pay him a tremis; cmp. Bab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:4:5">Y. Kidd. II, 62ᵈ</cite> <he>דינר קורדיינא</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:8:2">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᵈ</cite> top <he>דינרא ק׳</he>.
